title: A General Design-Based Framework and Estimator for Randomized Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2210.08698v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We describe a widely applicable design-based framework for drawing causal inference in randomized experiments. Causal effects are defined as linear functionals evaluated at unit-level potential outcome functions. Assumptions about the potential outcome functions are encoded as function spaces. This makes the framework expressive, allowing experimenters to formulate and investigate a wide range of causal questions that previously could not be investigated with design-based methods. The framework is particularly suited for complex, non-discrete interventions and causal interference. We describe a class of estimators for estimands defined using the framework and investigate their properties. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for unbiasedness and consistency. translated_title: 随机化实验的通用基于设计框架与估计量
translated_abstract: 我们描述了一个广泛适用的基于设计的框架，用于在随机化实验中进行因果推断。因果效应被定义为在单元级潜在结果函数上取值的线性泛函。关于潜在结果函数的假设被编码为函数空间。这使得该框架具有很强的表达能力，使实验者能够提出并研究以前无法用基于设计的方法进行研究的广泛因果问题。该框架特别适合于复杂的、非离散的干预以及因果干扰的情形。我们描述了针对用该框架定义的估计量的一类估计器，并研究了它们的性质。我们给出了无偏性和一致性的充要条件。我们还描述了一类保守方差估计器，其有助于置信区间的构建。为了展示我们（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个通用的基于设计的随机化实验因果推断框架，将因果效应定义为潜在结果函数上的线性泛函，特别适用于复杂非离散干预和因果干扰情形，并给出了估计量无偏性和一致性的充要条件以及保守方差估计器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general design-based framework for causal inference in randomized experiments, defining causal effects as linear functionals of unit-level potential outcome functions, which is particularly suited for complex non-discrete interventions and interference, and provides estimators with necessary and sufficient conditions for unbiasedness and consistency along with conservative variance estimators.
